paragraphs: Family Farmstead Dairy of Worcester, NY is recalling raw mild cheddar cheese due to potential E. coli O157:H7 contamination [1][10]. E. coli O157:H7 causes diarrheal illness often with bloody stools [1]. The cheese was distributed to grocers in New York and New Jersey [10].

Oliva LLC is recalling Riad's Oliva to Go Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus due to undeclared sesame [5]. People with sesame allergies or severe sensitivity run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reactions [5]. Pan Pepín Inc. is also recalling certain lots of Para Bien Al Grano because it contains undeclared sesame [3]. Additionally, Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. of Brooklyn, New York is recalling STARFISH SEAFOOD PREMIUM COLD SMOKED NORWEGIAN SALMON SLICED (227g/8oz) packages due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination, which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections [6].

An E. coli outbreak linked to chicken wraps is growing, though the FDA and USDA have not revealed the brand [7]. The USDA is expanding testing for Listeria in deli meat processors following changes to oversight of ready-to-eat facilities [18].
